title: Original Portal V2 signed GET must confirm ALL authored BusinessInput root fields
root_cause: createPortalStateClient.write used portalAuthoringReadbackMatches only for nextState.portal, although buildPortalBusinessInput includes non-derived authored top-level keys. 2xx plus partial readback could incorrectly report saved.
impact: Potential stale non-portal authored values silently acknowledged despite original canonical write. No actual affected customer or lost data independently demonstrated.
fix: Compare the identical authored answers from existing buildPortalBusinessInput(nextState).answers to authenticated GET state, preserving strict canonical and projection ACK; exclude already defined derived read-model keys.
prevention_rule: Every authored canonical BusinessInput root key must survive the same authenticated write→GET; absent or mismatched field remains unsaved/error, not green; no extra store, worker or auth bypass.
owner: original Portal V2 #4215; existing agent-data-quality/agent-website-ux and ONE BRAIN consumer
evidence: Source inspection on 2026-11-12: previous readback checked only nextState?.portal against received.state?.portal
Two new regression cases for stale root-level field and derived read-model exclusion
status_boundary: SOURCE_FIX_CANDIDATE_ONLY; authenticated multi-tenant runtime and original Brain/Heartbeat consumer processed ACK, provider outcome, CRO holdout and next-run learning remain EVIDENCE_DUE
